title: Classical Verification of a Remote Quantum Processor via Degenerate Concordant Computations: An Application to Randomness Generation
summary: A client renting a cloud quantum processor cannot easily tell whether its bitstrings came from a quantum device. Certification by random circuit sampling runs on present hardware, but scoring each sample costs $O(2^n)$. We give a protocol in which the client scores each round in $O(n)$ time, based on degenerate concordant ensembles: mixed states that are classical probability distributions over a product basis, with several basis states sharing a probability.
